name: Compound interest
description: Future value of savings or investments with compounding.
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/,(?=\d{3})/g,'');const money=t.match(/(?:\$|£|€|usd\s*)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(k|thousand|million|m)?\b|(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(k|thousand|million)?\s*(?:dollars|pounds|euros|usd)\b/);const mult=s=>s?(/^(k|thousand)$/.test(s)?1e3:1e6):1;let P=money?(+(money[1]||money[3]))*mult(money[2]||money[4]):null;const rate=t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(%|percent)/);const yrs=t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(years?|yrs?)/);const mos=t.match(/(\d+)\s*months?\b(?!ly)/);if(P==null){const nums=(t.match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(n=>!rate||n!=+rate[1]).filter(n=>!yrs||n!=+yrs[1]);P=nums.sort((a,b)=>b-a)[0]}if(P==null||!rate||!(yrs||mos))return{answer:null,reason:'Need an amount, a rate and a time.'};const r=+rate[1]/100,Y=yrs?+yrs[1]:+mos[1]/12;const N=/continuous/.test(t)?Infinity:/daily/.test(t)?365:/weekly/.test(t)?52:/monthly/.test(t)?12:/quarterly/.test(t)?4:/semi-?annual|twice a year/.test(t)?2:1;const A=N===Infinity?P*Math.exp(r*Y):P*Math.pow(1+r/N,N*Y);const f=v=>v.toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});return{answer:`${f(A)} (interest earned: ${f(A-P)})`,steps:[`Principal P = ${f(P)}, rate r = ${r*100}% = ${r}, time t = ${+Y.toFixed(4)} years`,N===Infinity?'Compounded continuously: A = P·e^(r·t)':`Compounded ${N} time${N>1?'s':''} a year: A = P·(1 + r/${N})^(${N}·t)`,`A = ${f(A)}`,`Interest = A − P = ${f(A-P)}`]}}

tests.q: If I invest $5000 at 4% compounded monthly for 10 years how much will I have?
